categories.main_business_segments: Pool Corporation is the world's largest wholesale distributor of swimming pool supplies, equipment and related leisure products, and one of the leading distributors of irrigation and landscape maintenance products in the United States. The company operates through five distribution networks: SCP Distributors, Superior Pool Products, Horizon Distributors, National Pool Tile (NPT), and Sun Wholesale Supply, serving approximately 125,000 customers across 439 sales centers in North America, Europe and Australia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages warehouse management technology for inventory optimization, operates centralized shipping locations for bulk redistribution, and has invested in digital transformation platforms including Pool360 (with WaterTest and PoolService tools), Horizon 24/7, and BlueStreak mobile ordering. The company also owns and operates a chemical re-packaging plant acquired through the Porpoise Pool & Patio acquisition, utilizing velocity slotting technology to identify and position fast-moving inventory items for operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include swimming pool remodelers and builders, specialty retailers (including Pinch A Penny franchise stores), pool repair and service businesses, irrigation construction and landscape maintenance contractors, and commercial pool operators. The company's largest markets are California, Texas, Florida and Arizona, collectively representing approximately 54% of 2023 net sales, with approximately 95% of sales in North America, 4% in Europe and 1% in Australia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates 439 sales centers across North America (including Canada and Mexico), Europe and Australia. Domestic operations include 392 sales centers across the United States, while international operations include 47 sales centers in Canada (17), France (8), Australia (6), Mexico (5), Portugal (3), Italy (2), Spain (2), and one each in Belgium, Croatia, Germany and United Kingdom. The company generated approximately 95% of sales in North America in 2023.
categories.supply_chain_position: Pool Corporation operates as a midstream distributor in the swimming pool and irrigation supply chains. The company purchases products from a large number of manufacturers and efficiently distributes them to a highly fragmented customer base of small, family-owned businesses and specialty retailers. The company adds value by obtaining more favorable terms from manufacturers than individual customers could obtain independently and providing comprehensive product assortment and customer service.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include promoting industry growth through digital marketing and consumer awareness programs, promoting customer business growth through product training and marketing support, and operating more effectively through capacity creation and digital transformation. Key R&D initiatives include expanding the Pool360 suite of technologies, developing energy-efficient and environmentally sustainable products, expanding commercial pool market offerings, and investing in automation and technology to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of swimming pool supplies, equipment, chemicals, irrigation products, landscape maintenance products, building materials, and related outdoor living products. Revenue is derived from sales to contractors, specialty retailers, service businesses, and commercial operators. Approximately 62% of 2023 sales came from maintenance and minor repair products (non-discretionary), 24% from remodel and renovation products (partially discretionary), and 14% from new construction products (discretionary).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Pool Corporation is the largest wholesale distributor of swimming pool supplies in the United States and one of the only national wholesale distributors focused on the swimming pool industry. The company faces competition from regional and local distributors, three national wholesale distributors of irrigation and landscape supplies, mass market retailers, and large pool supply retailers who purchase directly from manufacturers. The company competes on breadth of product offerings, quality of customer service, sales and marketing programs, business relationship stability, pricing, and geographic proximity.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Pool Corporation is a large-cap company with 2023 net sales of $5.5 billion, down 10% from $6.2 billion in 2022, representing a 15% compound annual growth rate from 2019 to 2023. Net income declined 30% to $523.2 million in 2023 from $748.5 million in 2022. Diluted earnings per share decreased 29% to $13.35 in 2023 from $18.70 in 2022. The company is a member of the S&P 500 Index with a market capitalization of approximately $14.2 billion as of June 30, 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Pool Corporation differentiates through its comprehensive product assortment of over 200,000 manufacturer and proprietary brand products, extensive network of conveniently located sales centers providing local market expertise, superior customer service and support programs including training and marketing assistance, digital transformation tools that improve customer productivity, and focus on energy-efficient and environmentally sustainable products. The company emphasizes being a trusted resource for industry professionals, retailers and consumers while helping customers grow their businesses and promoting overall industry growth.
